newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Edegel signs $135 mln contracts.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Edegel signs $135 mln contracts.

text.p: Electricity firm Edegel said Tuesday it has signed supply contracts with two local companies worth $135 million over 10 years.

Edegel said in a statement it had signed a $120 million contract with Empresa Siderurgica del Peru (Siderperu) -- the country's largest producer of steel -- to supply its installations with electricity for 10 years.
The second $15 million contract was signed with mining company Buenaventura SA to exclusively supply energy to its mining unit Uchucchacua for 10 years.
Edegel is Peru's top private generator and a blue chip stock on the Lima bolsa.
